mapper.select: select COVER_POSTS_IDX, HOPE_JOB, HOPE_REGION, EDUCATION, MILITARY_STATUS, CAREER, KEYSKILL, CERTIFICATION, LANGUAGE_SKILL, PERSONALITY, JOB_EXPERIENCE, JOBSEEKER_IDX from COVER_POSTS where JOBSEEKER_IDX = #{jobseekerIdx};
select JOB_POSTS_IDX, VIEW_COUNT, ATTACH_FILE, TITLE, EMPLOYMENT_TYPE, SALARY, WORK_TIME, CAREER, EDUCATION, TECH_STACK, APPLICATION_PERIOD, COMPANY_IDX from JOB_POSTS;
mapper.insert: insert into JOBSEEKER_MATCHING ( JOB_MATCH_SCORE, JOB_AI_REASON, MATCHING_CREATEAT, JOBSEEKER_IDX, COMPANY_IDX, JOB_POSTS_IDX, COVER_POSTS_IDX ) values ( #{score}, #{reason}, SYSDATE(), #{jobseekerIdx}, #{companyIdx}, #{jobPostsIdx}, #{coverPostsIdx} )
mapper.select: select jm.JOB_MATCH_SCORE as score, cu.COMPANY_NAME as company, jp.TITLE as title, jp.SALARY as salary, cu.COMPANY_REGION as loc, jm.JOB_AI_REASON as reason from JOBSEEKER_MATCHING jm inner join COMPANY_USERS cu on jm.COMPANY_IDX = cu.COMPANY_IDX inner join JOB_POSTS jp on jm.JOB_POSTS_IDX = jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX where JOBSEEKER_IDX = #{jobseekerIdx} order by jm.JOB_MATCH_SCORE desc limit #{topN}
SELECT COVER_POSTS_IDX FROM COVER_POSTS WHERE JOBSEEKER_IDX = #{jobseekerIdx} ORDER BY COVER_POSTS_IDX DESC LIMIT 1
